text:
mira.khan: Quick heads-up — Support flagged a pattern: embeddings API returning 400/422 for some customers when they send mixed-dimension vectors in one batch. Repro by sending 768+1536 together.

alex.cheng: Do we validate per-item dim today or just trust model selection?

mira.khan: Runtime checks model compatibility but not per-item dims. We try to coerce/pad and eventually hit `invalid input shape` deep in the kernel. Error is useless for users.

daniel: Can we see sample payloads from support? We don't currently emit item-level dims in telemetry, so hard to measure how common this is.

jess_ops: From the ticket — customer POSTed payload like:```json
{
  "model": "rw-embed-1",
  "inputs": [[0.1,0.2,...,0.3], [0.5,0.6]]
}
```first item ~1536, second ~768. They expect server to either normalize or return a clear error.

alex.cheng: Proposal: (A) Preflight validate each vector length against model.dim and reject early with a structured 4xx (not generic runtime error). (B) Emit telemetry: histogram of item dims per request + flag for mixed_dims.

mira.khan: Also console UX gap: route config and model switcher show tokens/throughput but not expected embedding dim or per-request payload bytes. Customers switch models and suddenly hit rejects.

daniel: Quotas semantics too — we currently bill embedding-units per vector count. Should clarify whether quota = sum(vector_count * model_dim) or still per-vector. If billing is dimension-sensitive customers need that spelled out.

jess_ops: UX suggestion: when user selects an embed model in Console show "Expected dim: 1536" and a small help text: "Requests with mixed or incorrect dims will return 4xx unless tenant opt-in to padding."

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-platform/validate-embed-dims at 2024-12-09T15:00Z

alex.cheng: Implementation sketch: runtime preflight that checks len(vec) for each input. If mismatch -> return 422 with JSON body like `{
  "error":"embedding_dim_mismatch",
  "expected":1536,
  "found_counts":{"768":3,"1536":7}
}` and header `X-Embed-Expected-Dim: 1536`. That helps SDKs auto-correct.

mira.khan: I like the header. Also consider `X-Embed-Allowed-Padding: false` or a tenant-level flag.

daniel: Telemetry metrics to add to event catalog: `embed.request.batch_size` (gauge), `embed.request.item_dim_hist` (histogram), `embed.request.mixed_dims` (boolean tag). Makes Optimize and console insights useful for QC.

jess_ops: Console: add a badge on route row when `mixed_dims_rate > 1%` with tooltip "Mixed-dim inputs detected — may cause rejects" and link to docs + migration snippet.

alex.cheng: Edge case: legacy behavior — some customers relied on padding or truncation behavior (we might have been forgiving). We can't flip silently. Add feature flag `runtime.allow_dim_padding` default false. Allow tenant opt-in via account settings.

mira.khan: We'll coordinate support comms and an SDK helper that normalizes dims (split batches by dim or pad). Add migration guide with examples in Python/TS.

daniel: Support also noted some 413s for very large embedding payloads. We should return clearer limits: `413 Payload Too Large` with headers `X-Embed-Max-Items` and `X-Embed-Max-Bytes` plus `Retry-After` semantics for transient quota limits.

alex.cheng: Agree; runtime should compute per-request payload bytes (rough approximation) and compare to per-route/per-model limits. If over, return 413 + those headers. For dims-mismatch we use 422. Tests: add integration tests that send mixed-dim batches, oversized batches, and assert headers + JSON error shape.

jess_ops: I'll update Console mockups — route advisory panel will show: expected dim, max items, max payload bytes, and a toggle for "Allow dim padding (opt-in)". Copy will mention billing semantics.

mira.khan: I'll open RFC and tracking ticket. Action owners: Alex (runtime change + tests), Daniel (telemetry schema + event catalog), Jess (console mocks + copy), Support will prepare comms and sample scripts.

support: Customer asked for an example error they can match on. Suggest we publish: `{"error":"embedding_dim_mismatch","expected":1536}` and include `X-Embed-Expected-Dim` header. Will help automation.

alex.cheng: Noted. Also adding integration test that ensures older tenants with `runtime.allow_dim_padding=true` still get padding behavior (and metrics show padded=true).

daniel: For billing clarity, propose doc section: "Embeddings billing = vector_count * model_dim_units" (or whatever final decided). If we change counting semantics post-facto we'll add migration window.

mira.khan: Good. Let's ship small incremental change: validate + clear 4xx + telemetry. Don't flip padding default until comms complete. Sync next eng-platform standup. :thumbsup:
